toc.title: What does my campaign dashboard track?
Track Quick Promote results in your dashboard

runs: When you’re trying to grow your business, setting goals and tracking your performance in a timely and accurate manner is critical.
Your campaign dashboard has the results you need to optimize your >x< Ads campaigns.
What does my campaign dashboard track?
- This is how many times your ads have been seen by people on >x<.
- These are the actions that are directly tied to your campaign objective(s). For example, if your goal is website traffic, the results tracked will be link clicks.
- This is the number of impressions for your ads divided by the number of results.
- This is how much you’re paying, on average, for each relevant action people are taking from your ads.
You can see these results across all campaigns, or segmented by:
See the average results for your website traffic campaigns, or the average results for your reach campaigns.
See how specific campaigns are performing against your goals.
See which combinations of copy and creative are contributing the most to your campaigns.
See which of your targeted audiences are responding the most to your ads.

to understand exactly how every dollar spent on >x< contributes to your desired results.
